out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed multiple spray bottles of sanitizer being stored on a shelf with food equipment
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. PIC MOVED SANITIZER BOTTLES NEXT TO THE TRASH CAN AWAY FOR FOOD EQUIPMENT.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The basin of the small white hand sink was observed draining slow
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PLEASE CORRECT BY THE NEXT ROUTINE.
